source: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2025/2621 (default-value mark-up for the definitive period)
note: When embedded emissions are determined with DEFAULT values (rather than verified actual values), a mark-up is added to the resulting figure. The mark-up escalates by import year to incentivise use of verified actual data. For iron & steel, aluminium and cement the mark-up is 10% (2026), 20% (2027) and 30% (from 2028). For fertilisers it is capped at 1% across all years. Hydrogen and electricity have no mark-up under this table. Confirm against the binding Regulation before production use.
